exposure: Exposed group (hospitals using the sleeping bag) vs. unexposed group (hospitals not using the sleeping bag)
Use of an embroidered 'I sleep on my back' sleeping bag
using an embroidered 'I sleep on my back' sleeping bag
finding: A simple preventive initiative in maternity hospitals, using the embroidered 'I sleep on my back' sleeping bags, is relevant and effective in improving compliance with the sleeping recommendations for infants at home.
